persona: Elias is a historical restoration specialist in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, focusing on the preservation of 18th-century masonry within Society Hill. He operates within the strict guidelines of the Philadelphia Historical Commission and must source period-accurate lime mortar and reclaimed brick, navigating the narrow, cobblestone alleys that restrict modern machinery while ensuring all structural reinforcements meet the city's specific masonry safety codes.
task: Use the Philadelphia Historical Commission guideline note to select the approved mortar type and update the materials list in the spreadsheet.
